wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 10-004 wires the shareware-roster monster attack codepointers via one src/vanilla facade (wireMonsterAttacks.ts) re-exporting the read-only src/ai/attacks.ts named-roster subset (aFaceTarget, aPosAttack zombieman, aSPosAttack shotgun guy, aCPosAttack/aCPosRefire chaingunner, aTroopAttack imp, aSargAttack demon/spectre, aHeadAttack cacodemon, aBruisAttack Baron/E1M8 boss) plus MONSTER_ATTACK_ACTION_COUNT 105, wireMonsterAttackActions, and the attack context. VANILLA_MONSTER_ATTACK_INVARIANTS pins five rules (A_FaceTarget precedes every attack with shadow jitter; hitscan zombies use pos/spos/cpos; imp/baron melee-or-missile branch; sarg pure melee bite; 105-codepointer registry). The focused test exercises the registry count, the callable shareware attack codepointers, the frozen manifest, the ../-filtered specifier set, and dynamic same-reference identity, keeping the test inventory-neutral. No const enums in attacks.ts; single-module barrel so no duplicate-name risk.
